rows.26:15120:
With that, he went back to the gym.
I thought it was weird, but I went back to the gym too.
At the time, I didn't notice at all.
That he had changed.
Until then, Tsuda had been very quiet, not the type to take the initiative.
And yet, all of a sudden, he'd become really outgoing.{p}
rows.26:15264:
At first I didn't notice.
But you know, as the days went by, he kept changing more and more.
He'd never been popular with girls, but suddenly he was a big hit and all.
Anyway, he became like a completely different person.
So, you know, I asked him.
What had happened to him.
He grinned and answered.
"I've got something good to tell you.
I guess I can tell you, Hosoda."{p}
rows.26:13790:
After that, apparently he was in the hospital for a while.
He'd had a nervous breakdown, they say.
So people decided the rumor about the monster was true.
Even now, nobody goes near the place, they say.
But I wonder why tanuki cubs showed up there.
Strange, isn't it?
Maybe it has something to do with Ponkichi.
But that doesn't really matter, does it?
Either way, something shows up there.
In fact, I hear it still does, even now.
Around March this year, they tried to tear that restroom down.
And three of the workers who came for the job died mysterious deaths.
Even though they'd had it properly exorcised.
I'm thinking of looking into that restroom myself sometime.
When I do, will you come too, {a}{f:|}?
I'd feel nervous going all by myself.{p}
